Name: Default Window Size
Author: DecidedlyHuman
Description:
[img]https://img.shields.io/github/license/DecidedlyHuman/StardewValleyMods[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029182.png[/img]
Ever wanted Stardew Valley to start up in a specific windowed resolution? Well, this mod will do that for you.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1772988167.png[/img]
The usage is fairly simple. There's a config file generated when the mod first runs, and you can specify whether the game should start using the resolution you enter in there or not. [b]The file is generated in the mod's folder the first time the mod runs. [/b]So just run the game with the mod installed once, close it, and set the starting resolution in the config. It also has GMCM support to make changing the config much simpler.

[b]Note: There's a known bug with high-DPI scaling on Windows, where the specified resolutions are multiplied by the high DPI scaling percentage. E.g., 200% high DPI scale = a 2x multiplier to the resolutions you set. This may happen on other operating systems, but I don't know.

Do also note that attempting to set Stardew Valley's window size to below 1280x720 won't work, because the game hard caps it. There used a be a mod that removed the cap, but it's currently not working. I might get around to replicating it here at some point, but no promises![/b]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763028878.png[/img][/b]
